title: Solmai teamed up with LLUCID for the latest single, "Do You."
htmlContent:
The fast-rising artist Solmai teamed up with Berlin-based singer-songwriter LLUCID to release a new single, "Do You." This engaging release, "Do You," arrives just in time. Combining heartfelt RnB melodies with a fast-paced rap concert over a swirling but soft instrumental, the song takes you on a ride while staying low-key. Following up with the recently released singles "6 Shots Down" and "Feeling Myself Again."

The latest from Solmai and LLUCID is a heartfelt release from the singers that touches on the uncertainty of falling for somebody in its lyricism.
